class_guess: exponential counter with an exact macro cycle M(X) -> M(2^36 X + c) (175); 489 is a deeper tower regime
summary: After about 4.1e18 steps line 175 repeats one exact cycle: big run X -> 2^36 X + 9575900996480.
mechanism: Runs of 4-cell words; a marker crosses a run one word per left-end visit and turns each word into two, `(0100)^a 1^2 (0001)^(b+1) -> (0100)^(a+2) 1^2 (0001)^b` (20/20), so transfers are x -> 2x + c; nothing ever halves. Halting needs `B> 0 1 1` (E is entered only from C1, C only from B0).

From qsim record 21 (step 4,111,147,719,584,449,981) the record sequence is periodic with period 42: `M(X) = 0^inf 1 1011^X 10111110 1110^26 <A 01010100010000010001000100001 0^inf` goes to M(2^36 X + 9575900996480), every other field a fixed constant, 56/56 periods exact. All 42 segments of the period re-run by plain simulation from constructed configurations with small random X (same residue mod 64): 165/165; their fitted maps compose to exactly 2^36 X + 9575900996480. X stays fixed mod 2^36, so the 3 parity-flagged qsim rules always end on the same parity.

Line 489 (same table, start D, mirrored) is not in the cycle: two far fields Y1 = 9.4e17, Y2 = 1.05e19 are eaten linearly, D(Y1,Y2,X) -> D(Y1-48, Y2-240, 2^40 X + 377451701380050) per 40 records; Y1 runs out after 1.96e16 periods, at tower depth, with an unknown outcome.
